newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: World Bank approves $28.8 mln credit for Pakistan.
newsitem.headline: World Bank approves $28.8 mln credit for Pakistan.

text.p: The World Bank on Wednesday announced approval of a $28.8 million credit to Pakistan for a financial reporting and auditing project.

The project is designed to enhance public setor accounting and financial systems, provide the basis for enhancing public sector accountability and support improved institutional capacity for economic policy-making and management, a World Bank statement issued in Islamabad said.
It said the credit would be provided by the International Development Association (IDA), the World Bank's concessionary lending arm, on its standard terms, with a 35-year maturity.
The total project cost is estimated at $37.2 million, of which IDA will finance $28.8 million and the Government of Pakistan $8.4 million, the statement said.
